release.title: AI for BrickLink Studio: meet BrickBuilder Studio
release.subtitle: Create custom AI brick designs, make manual edits, and bring your models back for AI revisions and parts ordering.

tutorial.title: How to use AI with BrickLink Studio: the BrickBuilder workflow
tutorial.subtitle: Create a design, edit it in BrickBuilder Studio, optionally use native Studio, then return for AI edits and parts ordering.

sources.supports: Native Studio opens/imports LDraw and other model formats.
Native Studio exports LDraw through File > Export As.
LDraw units, color codes, placement matrices and file syntax.
Live toolbar, part editing, LDraw import/export and handoff actions verified in Brave and the in-app browser.
Live transfer reaches landing-page edit stage; return button sends model back; imported model order page requires AI validation.
